rationale: The short thesis remains largely intact — GDS is still ~0.24 below session VWAP ($23.69) in a risk-off tape (SPY -0.85%, VIXY +6.40%) and sits at just the 13.8th percentile of today's range — while the adverse move is a modest bounce to $23.45 that has not approached the $23.62 invalidation. With risk to invalidation (~$0.17) versus reward to the $23.05 target (~$0.40) still favorable and the position essentially flat (-0.15%), holding is the best-supported of the three actions. Confidence is muted because price has drifted back above the 5m 9-EMA and the last several 1m bars are slightly green, weakening one entry criterion.
